## About
Silver Eagle Auto Service is a neighborhood repair shop on NW Vivion Rd in Riverside. We work on the everyday things that keep a car running, like brakes and rotors, shocks and struts, air conditioning and cooling systems, and tires, along with bigger jobs like engine and transmission swaps.
Customers have given us a 4.7 rating across 69 Google reviews. One longtime customer put it simply: we explain the problem, provide options, and keep it budget friendly. Another said we have never tried to upsell or mislead her. That is how we want every visit to go.

## Services
- Brakes and rotor repair: Pads, rotors and brake work to keep you stopping safely.
- Shocks and struts repair: Repair for worn shocks and struts that affect ride and handling.
- Air conditioning repair: Getting your A/C blowing cold again.
- Radiator and cooling repair: Radiator and cooling system repair to keep your engine from overheating.
- Tire pressure monitoring system repair: Fixing TPMS sensors and warning lights.
- Tire mounting and balancing: Mounting and balancing for a smooth ride.
- Engine and transmission swaps: Larger jobs when an engine or transmission needs replacing.
